'''Tentrix''' was a vast, beautiful [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tentrix system/Legends|Tentrix system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

It was to this planet that a young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], piloting a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] alongside fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] pilot [[Garen Muln]], escorted the massive [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[BioCruiser]]'' after it had been torpedoed by [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] of [[Offworld Mining Corporation]] ([[UniFy]]), which was, ironically, also the dying transport's owner.
